title: Experiments
summary: A fair test of what works, for one person, before it goes into a manual.

stories.want: to find out which way of breaking a fast suits me
stories.soThat: I decide from my own results, not my mood on the day

requirements.text: An experiment has at most four options, and the coach is told to design two to four.

history.text: An experiment compares two to four options.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: only the maximum of four is enforced.

requirements.text: Unless the user chose to pick, the app picks the next option: the one with the fewest trials, then the least recently used; a trial opened by a fast always starts on that option and can be switched.

history.text: Unless the user chose to pick, the app picks the next option: the one with the fewest trials.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't give the tie-break or what happens for trials a fast opens.

requirements.text: What counts as better (ratings, diary numbers) is recorded when the experiment is set up, and the coach is told not to change it after trials begin.

history.text: What counts as better (ratings, diary numbers) is fixed when the experiment is set up.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: the measures can still be revised; only the prompt holds them fixed.

requirements.text: A trial counts as awaiting a rating from `experiment.rate-after` after it starts; a rating can be given earlier.

history.text: The rating for a trial is asked for `experiment.rate-after` after it.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't say how the rating is asked for; no prompt fires at that time.

requirements.text: A fasting experiment opens a trial by itself when a fast that reached half its goal ends, once per fast.

history.text: A fasting experiment opens a trial by itself when a fast ends.
history.reason: Version 1 left out the half-goal condition.

requirements.text: When every option has its trials, the coach's prompt says the experiment is ready to conclude; concluding records the result and the manual it went into.

history.text: When enough trials are in, the coach writes up the result and, if it held, carries it into the manual it was about.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: nothing happens automatically, and carrying the result into the manual is the coach's job.
